title: Sync, Reason, Act, on the Wire
kicker: One line of the goal, played over pull request 501 as the forge served it
html:
Sync, Reason, Act, on the Wire

GET /repos/acme/web/pulls/501   200 application/hal+json
{
  "number": 501,
  "state": "open",
  "merged": false,
  "_forms": {
    "scm:close": { … },
    "scm:merge": { "method": "PUT",
      "schema": { "method": { "enum": ["merge", "squash", "rebase"] } },
      "hr:integrity": "sha256-sGUdrPfH…" },
    "scm:comment": { … }, "scm:label": { … }, "scm:edit": { … },
    "scm:request-review": { … }, "scm:update-branch": { … }
  }
}
  1. Sync read 501 and its seven offers
  2. Reason walk: Claude picks scm:merge, squash · replay: the pin holds
  3. Act PUT …/actions/merge {"method": "squash"}, 200
  4. Sync merged; scm:merge no longer offered
say: Zoom into one line of the goal: merge it by squashing. Sync: ARTIE gets pull request 501 and reads what it is and what it offers, seven forms, each with its hash. Reason: on the walk, Claude reads the goal's words against those seven and picks scm:merge, method squash, because I said by squashing. Act: fill the form the server offered, send it to its target. And sync again: the answer is the next state. Merged, closed, and scm:merge is gone; you can't merge twice because nobody offers it. Now flip to the replay: the reason step is a pin snapping shut. No model.
